caption:
This reel told me to "comment for the guide" 🙄 So here's the guide, free.

How to rank higher on Google Maps:
1. Pick the most specific category
2. Fill in every field: services, areas, hours
3. Post real photos every week
4. Ask every customer for a review and reply to all of them

Never buy fake reviews. Google deletes them.

Found in my own saved reels, sorted by SaveSort. Sort yours free, link in bio.

#localseo #googlebusinessprofile #smallbusiness #tradies #savedreels
